negative_cases.name: Non-monotonic sample time
negative_cases.mutation: Change one point hour so it precedes the previous point

negative_cases.name: Missing service trajectory
negative_cases.mutation: Remove one required service from one scenario

negative_cases.name: Dangling dependency
negative_cases.mutation: Reference a prerequisite service absent from the service catalog

negative_cases.name: Dependency cycle
negative_cases.mutation: Add a reverse edge that closes a directed cycle

negative_cases.name: Resource overrun
negative_cases.mutation: Set committed responder hours above available hours

negative_cases.name: Duplicate service trajectory
negative_cases.mutation: Add a second trajectory with an existing service_id

negative_cases.name: Wrong sample count
negative_cases.mutation: Remove one time sample from a trajectory

round_trip_requirements: Preserve every service_id, floor_percent, critical flag and unit exactly.
Preserve the shock_sequence_id and every stressor interval and severity label.
Preserve dependency direction and relationship semantics.
Preserve the exact sample hours and availability values without rounding or resampling.
Preserve planning-point and responder-hour units and denominators.
Preserve null sustained-recovery values as null; do not convert missing recovery to zero.
Preserve the public-development-only, synthetic and inactive status labels.
Preserve unknown namespaced extensions without silently interpreting or dropping them.
limitations: This corpus is formative and is not an independently held-out validation set.
Conformance requires at least two independently implemented adapters and a third-party verifier.
A reference implementation passing its own corpus is necessary but not sufficient evidence of interoperability.
